content:
Below is a namespaced Crossplane API using `function-patch-and-transform`. It creates:

- A private, versioned, AES-256-encrypted S3 bucket
- A PostgreSQL RDS instance with deletion protection and at least seven days of backups
- A least-privilege IAM role with an EKS OIDC/IRSA trust policy
- Environment-specific RDS sizing
- Environment/provider isolation through separate claims and `ProviderConfig` references
- Database passwords sourced from an existing Kubernetes Secret rather than embedded in Git

> Assumes the Upbound AWS provider and `function-patch-and-transform` are installed.

```yaml
# function.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
```

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversionedapplications.platform.example.io
spec:
  group: platform.example.io
  names:
    kind: XVersionedApplication
    plural: xversionedapplications
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedApplication
    plural: versionedapplications
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: versioned-application-aws
  connectionSecretKeys:
    - endpoint
    - port
    - username
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - spec
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - environment
                - region
                - providerConfigName
                - bucketName
                - database
                - irsa
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  description: Deployment environment.
                  enum:
                    - dev
                    - prod

                region:
                  type: string
                  description: AWS region used by the primary resources.
                  minLength: 1

                providerConfigName:
                  type: string
                  description: >
                    Environment-specific AWS ProviderConfig. Dev and prod
                    should use different ProviderConfigs/accounts or credentials.
                  minLength: 1

                bucketName:
                  type: string
                  description: Globally unique S3 bucket name.
                  minLength: 3
                  maxLength: 63
                  pattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'

                database:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - name
                    - username
                    - passwordSecretRef
                  properties:
                    name:
                      type: string
                      pattern: '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$'
                    username:
                      type: string
                      minLength: 1
                    allocatedStorage:
                      type: integer
                      minimum: 20
                      default: 20
                    subnetGroupName:
                      type: string
                      description: Existing RDS DB subnet group.
                    securityGroupIds:
                      type: array
                      description: Existing security groups allowed to reach PostgreSQL.
                      minItems: 1
                      items:
                        type: string
                    passwordSecretRef:
                      type: object
                      description: >
                        Reference to a Secret created outside Git, for example by
                        External Secrets, SOPS deployment, or a Crossplane SecretStore.
                      required:
                        - name
                        - namespace
                        - key
                      properties:
                        name:
                          type: string
                        namespace:
                          type: string
                        key:
                          type: string

                irsa:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - roleName
                    - oidcProviderArn
                    - oidcIssuer
                    - namespace
                    - serviceAccountName
                  properties:
                    roleName:
                      type: string
                      minLength: 1
                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: ARN of the EKS cluster IAM OIDC provider.
                      pattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:oidc-provider/.+$'
                    oidcIssuer:
                      type: string
                      description: >
                        OIDC issuer without the https:// prefix, for example
                        oidc.eks.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE.
                      minLength: 1
                    namespace:
                      type: string
                      minLength: 1
                    serviceAccountName:
                      type: string
                      minLength: 1

            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                databaseEndpoint:
                  type: string
                iamRoleArn:
                  type: string
```

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versioned-application-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
    platform.example.io/type: versioned-application
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedApplication

  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: create-aws-resources
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # The bucket is deliberately split into the resources used by the
          # current AWS S3 API: Bucket, versioning, encryption and public access.
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: assets
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  forceDestroy: false
                  tags:
                    managed-by: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: assets-versioning
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: assets-encryption
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: false
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: assets-public-access
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

          - name: database
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Instance
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: database
              spec:
                # Retain provides an additional guard beyond AWS deletion
                # protection if the claim is accidentally deleted.
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  deletionProtection: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  storageType: gp3
                  tags:
                    managed-by: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.username
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.allocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.subnetGroupName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.securityGroupIds
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIds
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.key
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.key

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: db.t3.micro
                      prod: db.t3.medium

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: false
                      prod: true

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      dev: false
                      prod: true

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.databaseEndpoint
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          - name: irsa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.io/resource: application-irsa
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  description: Least-privilege role used by the application service account
                  maxSessionDuration: 3600
                  tags:
                    managed-by: crossplane
                  inlinePolicy:
                    - name: application-assets
                      policy: "{}"
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.irsa.roleName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.irsa.roleName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment

              # IRSA trust policy. The issuer must be supplied without https://.
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.irsa.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.irsa.oidcIssuer
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.irsa.namespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.irsa.serviceAccountName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.irsa.oidcIssuer
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"%s"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"%s:sub":"system:serviceaccount:%s:%s","%s:aud":"sts.amazonaws.com"}}}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy

              # No wildcard actions. Access is limited to the selected bucket.
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"ListApplicationBucket","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s"},{"Sid":"AccessApplicationObjects","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.inlinePolicy[0].policy

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

    - step: automatically-detect-ready-composed-resources
      functionRef:
        name: function-auto-ready
```

The readiness step requires this function:

```yaml
# auto-ready-function.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-auto-ready
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready:v0.5.0
```

Example environment-specific claims:

```yaml
# dev.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedApplication
metadata:
  name: webapp-dev
  namespace: webapp-dev
spec:
  compositionRef:
    name: versioned-application-aws
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  providerConfigName: aws-dev
  bucketName: example-webapp-dev-assets-123456789012
  database:
    name: webapp
    username: webapp_admin
    allocatedStorage: 20
    subnetGroupName: webapp-dev
    securityGroupIds:
      - sg-0123456789abcdef0
    passwordSecretRef:
      name: webapp-db-credentials
      namespace: webapp-dev
      key: password
  irsa:
    roleName: webapp-dev
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
    oidcIssuer: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
    namespace: webapp-dev
    serviceAccountName: webapp
```

```yaml
# prod.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedApplication
metadata:
  name: webapp-prod
  namespace: webapp-prod
spec:
  compositionRef:
    name: versioned-application-aws
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  providerConfigName: aws-prod
  bucketName: example-webapp-prod-assets-123456789012
  database:
    name: webapp
    username: webapp_admin
    allocatedStorage: 100
    subnetGroupName: webapp-prod
    securityGroupIds:
      - sg-0fedcba9876543210
    passwordSecretRef:
      name: webapp-db-credentials
      namespace: webapp-prod
      key: password
  irsa:
    roleName: webapp-prod
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
    oidcIssuer: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
    namespace: webapp-prod
    serviceAccountName: webapp
```

The referenced password Secret should be materialized by SOPS/External Secrets or another secret manager and must not be committed in plaintext.

This implements the three resources requested. The broader canonical scenario’s EKS, HTTPS exposure, and production S3 cross-region replication require additional composed resources and are intentionally not represented by this focused XRD.
